resolved_suspects.description: Watcom field-by-field struct copy (3 consecutive `dst.field = src.field;` lines). Replace with `dst = src;` or `memcpy(&dst, &src, sizeof(...));` in a .keep — but only once the run (together with any sibling runs for the same dst/src pair) covers every byte of the struct. Collapsing a run that leaves a gap WIDENS the copy and changes behaviour; see `partial_struct_copy` (§31) for that case.

Watcom raw-offset struct copy (3 consecutive `*(T *)(base + 0xNN) = *(T *)(base + 0xNN);` lines copying a contiguous block). Ghidra lost the struct type; replace the run with a struct assignment or `memcpy(...)` in a .keep (find/create the matching struct type for the block).

Watcom inline memcpy (REP MOVSD at 0057e4b9, 4-byte stride). Ghidra reconstructs this as a countdown for-loop with element-by-element copies; replace the loop with memcpy(dst, src, count * 4) or a struct assignment in a .keep.
